posts.title: My first blog: how the ICAI Singapore Chapter helped me find my feet
posts.summary: A short and heartfelt look at my first months with the ICAI Singapore Chapter, from a shy first event to friends for life.
posts.body:
This is my first blog, written on my own website. Three years ago I could not have built this myself. Modern AI tools made it possible.

My membership with the ICAI Singapore Chapter was accepted on 27 June. I missed the first event I had planned to attend because I was unwell. The events that followed helped me meet people and understand the Singapore landscape.

## CA Day flag hoisting, early July

A small gathering at Mandarin Gardens. I was shy and found it hard to start conversations.

## Volunteering at ISCA Accounting City, 17 and 18 July

I sat at the ICAI booth for two days. This is where I came out of my shell. I connected with many CAs and learned how the finance job market works in Singapore. Hearing how others found opportunities after moving here was really useful. I also met CA Kushal Jaju, Dilip, Nikhil and our Chapter Chairperson, Sanjay Gattani.

## Transformation in Motion, 28 July

Real examples of change management. My takeaway was how cost overruns happen and why actual costs drift from the initial projections.

## ICAI International Conference 2026, ASEAN, 21 and 22 August

Professionals from across the world came together at Marina Bay Sands. It was a big initiative for our Chapter to pull off and I made friends for life here.

## Working Smarter with AI, 26 August

Practical AI ideas for finance from CA Shivam Palan and CA Kushal Jaju. I tried a few of them at home.

At my first event I hesitated to say hello. Since then I have volunteered, learned and made friends. Thank you to the ICAI Singapore Chapter for helping me find my feet in Singapore.
